512-3443-4091.easyPrerequisites: Deathbloom Ritualist and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
512-3443-4091.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
512-3443-4091.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Deathbloom Ritualist, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-3443-4091.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Deathbloom Ritualist's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

529-6791-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1339-1832-4050-6772.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-4050-6772.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Syr Vondam triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Repeat.

132-1379-4687-7013.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-1379-4687-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
132-1379-4687-7013.description:
Activate Myr Welder using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.
132-1379-4687-7013.notes: This combo only produces infinite mana if you control at least four creatures that share a creature type.

1308-2457-5794-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1619-5241.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-5241.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Sakashima the Impostor and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-5241.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1619-4605-5256-5542-6148.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6148.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Seasoned Dungeoneer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Seasoned Dungeoneer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Seasoned Dungeoneer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Seasoned Dungeoneer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6148.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

4659-5086-5183-6441-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4659-5086-5183-6441-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

149-918-2757--143.description:
Earthbend a basic land you control.
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting the earthbent land.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the earthbent land, targeting the earthbent land.
The land triggers, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to Donna Noble.
Donna Noble triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Earthcraft trigger, untapping the earthbent land.
Repeat from step 3.
149-918-2757--143.notes: The {G} in the mana cost can be waived if you earthbend a Forest and tap it for mana before casting Legolas's Quick Reflexes. You may need additional mana to earthbend the land depending on the method of earthbending used. You can also pair an indestructible creature with Donna Noble and use that creature instead.

3028-4094-5702.easyPrerequisites:
At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3028-4094-5702.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa, Vital Force
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 5.

628-5332-5670--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
628-5332-5670--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, and its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter on it. Carmen also triggers regardless.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat

Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.

Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.

Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.

Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.

Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1818-5010-5686-6900.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2178-2292-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
When the creature dies, Xu-Ifit triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.

Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.

Resolve the Ozox trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Jumblebones and the other creature token, adding {1}{B}.

Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.

When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Double.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Body Double, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.

974-2157-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Romana II does not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-2157-3750.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-5003-5727.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other nontoken artifact creature.
2034-5003-5727.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the artifact creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return the artifact creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When the artifact creature enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers, creating a 2/2 Human Knight creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Human Knight, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1799-2579-2701-4050-4863.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Revolutionist, adding one mana of any color.
When Revolutionist dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Revolutionist from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Revolutionist from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

997-2724-3217-3582.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder and adding {R} or {W} for each charge counter on Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Duergar Mine-Captain's ability by paying {1}{R/W} and untapping it, giving attacking creatures +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

282-914-3398.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
Delina and Hellkite Charger does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Delina and Hellkite Charger.
282-914-3398.description:
Declare Delina and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of Dockside Extortionist that is tapped and attacking.
The Dockside Extortionist token(s) enter the battlefield, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger from step 1, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, the Dockside Extortionist token triggers, exiling itself.
Repeat each combat phase.

957-2187-4702.description:
Cast Time Stretch getting an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Activate Possessed Skaab, by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
The token copy of Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

930-2034-2640-3225.notablePrerequisites: Smoke Shroud attached to Universal Automaton.
930-2034-2640-3225.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {C}{C}.
Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Universal Automaton for {1}.
Smoke Shroud triggers, returning from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Universal Automaton.
Repeat.

364-1283-1987-3277.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
